title: Bell with count badge
brief: A notifications button holding an inline SVG bell, with a red count badge pinned to its top-right corner. It lightens on hover and rings on focus.

inspiration.note: Took the count badge pinned to the corner of an icon button; ours is a cream tile with a cut-out ring around the badge.
Took the idea of a compact numeric count with strong contrast; the shape and colours are ours.
